baseline.source: authoritative tasks/backlog.json + tasks/goal_task_links.json at same read window; two reads, no atomic cross-store snapshot claim

cases.requirement: Keeper receives current-revision Goal criterion, measurement, evidence and explicit missing/unavailable state
Keeper chooses a matching Goal for related work and creates a Task with its goal_id
Task approval returns attention to the linked Goal measurement and unmet acceptance, without inferring Goal completion
Independent goalless Task creation and execution remain supported
Coding verify, regression and build execute inside the declared supported grading sandbox; Docker and microVM support boundaries are explicit
Changing only Node oracle code with broken solution unchanged cannot pass protected grading
Image bytes and length must match stored identity before judge or operator delivery
Model and experiment cohorts retain distinct pass@k, cost and unknown coverage
Changed experiment inputs cannot reuse stale resume evidence
Actual producer and judge identity coverage is represented honestly; unknown is not claimed independent
LLM approval, observed external acceptance and human Goal confirmation remain distinct facts

limits: No production rollout or candidate runtime proof yet
Historical Task counts include legitimate independent Tasks; link ratio is diagnostic, not a target or completion gate
